consequence.statement: The metallb-bgp flags bgp-config-path, bgp-announce-lb-ip and bgp-announce-pod-cidr have been removed. Configurations that still rely on them no longer get metallb-based BGP advertisements, because users are now required to use the Cilium BGP control plane.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading, move BGP advertisements to the Cilium BGP control plane and remove the metallb-bgp flags.

original.statement: Cilium 1.17.0 removes the deprecated metallb-bgp flags bgp-config-path, bgp-announce-lb-ip and bgp-announce-pod-cidr; BGP advertisements must now use the Cilium BGP control plane.

decision.reason: [ev-32984cccce52] says the three metallb-bgp flags were removed and that users must now use the Cilium BGP control plane for BGP advertisements. A removed flag that stops being honoured fits setting-ignored, and the statement and remediation stay within what the evidence says. Severity high is reasonable because BGP advertisements depend on these flags. The other items in the section [ev-98d8079a3380] and [ev-ffd2c3200e89] describe similar removals of deprecated options, and nothing in them contradicts this classification.
